annotations.title: Cancel a pending quote and/or revoke the agent-wallet budget

description: Kill switch for the agent's own spending. Two independent modes (at least one is required): (1) quote_id — cancels a pending quote/payment via POST /v1/quotes/:id/cancel. The PaymentCancellation EIP-712 signature is produced LOCALLY with PHANTOM_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY (or pass payer_signature precomputed). (2) account_id — revokes the agent-wallet budget via POST /v1/agent-wallet/revoke: remaining goes to 0 for future spending (already-spent funds are untouched). The AgentWalletRevocation EIP-712 signature is produced LOCALLY with PHANTOM_FUNDER_PRIVATE_KEY (or pass signature + funder_wallet precomputed). Both modes in one call run sequentially and the response reports the post-action state of each.

account_id.description: Account whose agent-wallet budget will be revoked, e.g. acc_... (kill switch total).

expires_in_minutes.description: Validity of the revocation signature in minutes (default 15, max 60).

funder_wallet.description: Funder wallet address, required only with a precomputed signature and no PHANTOM_FUNDER_PRIVATE_KEY.

nonce.description: Unique revocation nonce per funder (default: current timestamp in ms); replays return 409.

payer_signature.description: Precomputed EIP-712 PaymentCancellation signature (0x, 65 bytes); skips local signing with PHANTOM_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY.

quote_id.description: Quote/payment intent ID to cancel (kill switch parcial for one pending payment).

signature.description: Precomputed EIP-712 AgentWalletRevocation signature (0x, 65 bytes); skips local signing with PHANTOM_FUNDER_PRIVATE_KEY.

name: phantom_cancel

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
